content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.office_of_the_district_ayush_society_ri_: 12th passed, possessing a specialization in the following order of preference: ANM, Lab Technician, Panchakarma Technician, Health Attendant
Office of the I/c 10-Bedded Integrated AYUSH Hospital, Bhoirymbong

content_sections.heading: DAS Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 14/DM&HO/RBD/AYUSH/NAM/POSTS/2024 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download DAS notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Candidates with 12th passed possessing the specialization in the following order of preferences: a) ANM b) Lab Technician c) Panchakarma Technician d) Health Attendant Age limit: Maximum 32 years Age relaxation: SC/ST 5 years (as per OM No. PER 38/2021/30 Dt. 03/02/2022) Other conditions: Only candidates belonging to Bhoirymbong Block are invited to apply

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Contractual basis for a period of 11 months Renewable upon satisfactory performance

rows.event: Last Date for Submission of Hard Copy (up to 4 PM, working days only)

content_sections.heading: How Will DAS Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Screening of applications Written Test (if more than 30 candidates in each specialization) or direct Walk-in-interview (if fewer than 30) All applications go through a screening process constituted for the purpose Written test if the number of candidates in each specialization (ANM, Lab Technician, Panchakarma Technician, Health Attendant) is more than 30 Direct Walk-in-interview if the number is less than 30 Shortlisted candidates will be displayed on ribhoi.gov.in/dmho/

content_sections.heading: DAS Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the test or interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: All relevant certificates Testimonials ID card (EPIC, AADHAR, Driving Licence etc.) to be produced at the Written Test

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DAS Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Submit the application in hard copy to the Office of the I/c 10-Bedded Integrated AYUSH Hospital Bhoirymbong. Submit between 18/11/2026 and 30/11/2026 up to 4 PM, only on working days. Enclose all relevant certificates and testimonials with the application form.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No application will be entertained or accepted after the mentioned date Incomplete applications shall be summarily rejected No separate call letter or other communication will be issued regarding the written test The Undersigned reserves the right to reject any or all applications without assigning any reason in case of dispute

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DAS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DAS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Multi-purpose Worker (MPW).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DAS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to Office of the I/c 10-Bedded Integrated AYUSH Hospital, Bhoirymbong, by hard copy, to reach by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 32 years. Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years (as per OM No. PER 38/2021/30 Dt. 03/02/2022).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Fixed remuneration Rs.15,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 12th passed, possessing a specialization in the following order of preference: ANM, Lab Technician, Panchakarma Technician, Health Attendant.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only candidates belonging to Bhoirymbong Block are invited to apply.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening of applications. Written Test (if more than 30 candidates in each specialization) or direct Walk-in-interview (if fewer than 30). All applications go through a screening process constituted for the purpose. Written test if the number of candidates in each specialization (ANM, Lab Technician, Panchakarma Technician, Health Attendant) is more than 30.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contractual basis for a period of 11 months. Renewable upon satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bhoirymbong Block, Ri-Bhoi District.
